name: Yatoon Menu & Online Ordering
author: yatoon

sections.description:
Yatoon Menu & Online Ordering is a beautiful restaurant menu plugin for WordPress. Use it as a menu display only — perfect for restaurants that just want to show their menu online — or enable online ordering to accept pickup orders directly from your website.

Use as Menu Display Only

Simply disable the ordering feature in Settings and the plugin becomes a clean, beautiful digital menu. No cart, no checkout — just your menu with photos, categories, and prices. Perfect for restaurants that take orders by phone or in person.

Use with Online Ordering

Enable ordering to let customers browse your menu and place pickup orders directly on your website. Orders go straight to your admin dashboard with email notifications.

Features

  • Beautiful menu display with photos, categories, and prices
  • Toggle online ordering on/off with one click — use as menu-only or full ordering system
  • Category navigation with sticky header and mobile hamburger menu
  • Featured items carousel
  • Menu search
  • Online ordering for pickup (cash, free)
  • Kitchen display screen ([yatoon_kitchen] shortcode)
  • Order status tracking ([yatoon_order_status] shortcode)
  • Email order confirmations
  • Full admin order management
  • Mobile-friendly responsive design

Pro Version

  • Stripe payments — Accept credit card payments online
  • Alipay & WeChat Pay — Accept payments from Chinese customers
  • SMS notifications — Notify customers when their order is ready via text message
  • Customer accounts — Let customers create accounts, view order history
  • Google / Facebook login — One-click social login for customers
  • Priority support — Get help faster

Upgrade to Pro from within the plugin dashboard.

External Services

This plugin optionally connects to the following third-party services. All connections are opt-in and only activated when explicitly configured in the plugin settings.

This plugin works entirely locally — no external services are required or contacted.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Yatoon Menu → Settings to configure
  4. Add [yatoon_menu] shortcode to any page
sections.faq:
Can I use this as a menu display only, without online ordering?

Yes! Go to Yatoon Menu → Settings and turn off “Enable Online Ordering”. The plugin will display your menu beautifully without any cart or checkout functionality.

Does this plugin work without Stripe or any external accounts?

Yes! The free version works 100% locally. No Stripe, Twilio, or any other external service needed.

What shortcodes are available?

  • [yatoon_menu] — Displays the menu and ordering form
  • [yatoon_kitchen] — Kitchen display screen
  • [yatoon_order_status] — Customer order status tracker
